STAGE 1 (verifier 5: integration/resources). Goal: read the real entry point with the frozen configuration and the launch contract, and the path constants.
Read: CURVCTRL-SID/train_rqvae.py (lines 1-676), tests/test_paths.py, model/curvature_control.py, model/layers.py, model/frechet_poincare.py, model/model.py.
Observed: frozen constants EPOCHS=3000 (line 82), BATCH_SIZE_PER_RANK=1024 (83), LR=1e-3 (84), SEED=42 (100), nproc=4 (132), SINGLE_GPU_ENV="GENREC_SINGLE_GPU" (79); no early stop (loop range(1,EPOCHS+1) at 497). Root marker at 42-59 requires stage2_RQ-VAE+results+stage1_GeneEmbedding, RESULT_DIR = REPO_ROOT/results/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_CURVCTRL-SID (65); every write (151,158,160,597,598,629,630,632,650) is under RESULT_DIR.
BLOCKING: line 461 prints len(edges), and "edges" is never bound (only raw_edges at 452 and edge_sample at 459). grep of the file shows line 461 as the only bare "edges". NameError on rank 0 in every launch (single-GPU branch included) after DDP init + KMeans, so no epoch runs; ranks 1-3 then hang in the broadcast at 434-436 (NCCL timeout 3600).
Still open: whether tools.research.stage2.launcher.launch has the signature used at 664-670 (that path is outside this sandbox's read permission).

STAGE 2 (paths, cost, interfaces). Read: train_rqvae.py 444-495 and 532-533; model/curvature_control.py 136-168; model/layers.py 103-116, 172-238, 372-390; tests/test_curvature_control.py, test_curvature_wiring.py, test_mechanism.py, test_ddp.py, test_curvature_spec.py.
Observed: the measurement loop (_measure_curvature, 464-495) -> measure_levels (curvature_control.py:145) -> state["values"] -> layer.frechet.curvature (490) -> assignment_cost (layers.py:103-116) is a real joint pathway (Q_l drives the curved assignment and the curved commitment at 210).
BLOCKING defect: the two switches are inert in the real entry point. level_curvatures() (curvature_control.py:136-142) is called only by tests; measure_levels ignores use_behaviour/use_geometry (154-168) and _measure_curvature applies state["values"] directly (487-490). assignment_cost (layers.py:111-116) never consults frechet.use_curvature, and forward passes torch.ones as the weights (190-191) so frechet.use_behaviour cannot matter. Therefore USE_BEHAVIOUR=False and USE_GEOMETRY=False change neither the SID nor the gradient; geometry-off is not the Euclidean metric. tests/test_mechanism.test_the_three_arms_are_three_computations only differs because build() calls sklearn KMeans without random_state (numpy RNG, not reset by torch.manual_seed), so the inequality is KMeans noise.
Minor: RQLayer.forward (layers.py:384) passes item_ids positionally to vq_layer, while EMAVQLayer.forward (271-275) has no item_ids parameter -> TypeError for vq_type="ema" (frozen VQ_TYPE="vq", so no effect on the run). Minor: _LAUNCHER["master_port"]=50202 and ["log"] are unused.
Cost: no per-slot Python loop; assignment is a batched (B=1024, K=256, d=32) curved distance per level, 6 steps/epoch/rank (24556/4096), ~18000 steps, ~1 min total extra; the 5-epoch statistic pass is a ~24556x256x32 no_grad block (~0.8-2.4 GB transient, few hundred ms) every 5 epochs, not per step. Cost PASS.
Paths PASS (marker is unambiguous, own ARM_NAME dir, no writes outside it).

STAGE 3 final. Overall NEEDS_FIX. Check 1 integration NEEDS_FIX: blocking NameError at train_rqvae.py:461 (len(edges) undefined) so the real entry point cannot reach epoch 1 with the frozen config; minor unused 50202 master_port/_LAUNCHER["log"] (127-136). Check 2 paths/cost/interfaces NEEDS_FIX: blocking inert ablation switches (curvature_control.py:136-168 + train_rqvae.py:485-490 + layers.py:103-116,190-191) -- USE_BEHAVIOUR=False still drives c_l from Q_l and USE_GEOMETRY=False still uses the measured curved metric, so the required behaviour-off/geometry-off removals are not implemented; minor EMAVQLayer.forward lacks item_ids although RQLayer.forward:384 passes it; paths and per-step cost PASS. Key line numbers: EPOCHS 82, BATCH 83, LR 84, SEED 100, nproc 132, SINGLE_GPU_ENV 79, port stage2_contract.STAGE2_PORT 666, RESULT_DIR 65, marker 42-59.
